standards.title: Google Java Style & Clean Architecture
standards.description: Use 2-space indentation, explicit typing, immutable records/DTOs, and separation of Controller, Service, and Repository layers.
standards.evidence: Enforced in Spring Boot 3.3 Java 17 generated classes.

standards.title: Standardized REST API Error Envelope & HTTP Semantics
standards.description: All REST APIs must return RFC 7807 problem details or standardized response envelopes with trace IDs.

standards.title: Cloud-Native 12-Factor App & Statelessness
standards.description: Services must externalize configuration via environment variables / Secret Manager and remain stateless for autoscaling.
standards.evidence: Cloud Run serverless containers with Cloud SQL private VPC access.

standards.title: Zero-Trust IAM & Decoupled State Storage
standards.description: Service accounts must follow least-privilege RBAC. Infrastructure state must reside in versioned, customer-managed GCS buckets.
standards.evidence: Terraform state decoupled to GCS bucket; dedicated per-service IAM roles.

standards.title: Database Schema Migration via Flyway
standards.description: No direct schema mutations. All DDL and DML must be versioned Flyway migration scripts (V1__..., V2__...).
standards.evidence: Flyway migration scripts generated in src/main/resources/db/migration.

standards.title: CI/CD Pipeline Strict Exclusivity
standards.description: All deployments must flow through versioned Jenkins CI/CD pipelines with zero direct host execution.
standards.evidence: Dual Jenkinsfiles (db and app) staged in Jenkins folder.

standards.title: Hexagonal / Ports-and-Adapters Service Pattern
standards.description: Domain logic must be decoupled from persistence and presentation frameworks to allow independent unit testing.
standards.evidence: Domain service interfaces implemented independently of JPA repository details.

standards.title: Enterprise Spring Boot 3.3 Maven POM Template
standards.description: Standard dependency management BOMs, Spring Boot Actuator health checks, and Micrometer Prometheus metrics.
standards.evidence: pom.xml generated with standard enterprise dependencies and actuator endpoints.
